# Case Brief Template

Use this for private case notes and source-safe portfolio examples.

## Title

`Case NN - Mechanism Name`

## One-Line Read

What happened in one sentence, written without raw targets, payloads, or client
details.

## Mechanism

Name the reusable pattern:

- what trust boundary moved;
- what the model, agent, tool, file, or user did;
- what made the case interesting;
- what the final policy/security outcome was.

## Source-Safe Report Language

Short paragraph that can be shared publicly or in an application without raw
case material.

## Private Notes

Keep raw prompts, screenshots, target details, outputs, and client references in
ignored private notes only.
